label: M&E Framework Designer
description: Design a Monitoring & Evaluation framework: results framework, indicator selection (process/output/outcome/impact), data collection methods, baseline design, and reporting schedule.

claudeKnowledge.description: OECD DAC evaluation criteria, SMART indicators, results-based management

guidedInputs.label: Programme description and results logic
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. WASH programme in 40 villages: borehole rehabilitation, hygiene promotion, and water-committee strengthening, aiming at reduced waterborne disease incidence.

options.label: Full M&E framework (results framework + indicators + data plan + reporting)
Minimal — no dedicated M&E staff, paper-based collection
Moderate — part-time M&E officer, basic digital tools
Strong — dedicated M&E team, digital data collection (Kobo/ODK), evaluation budget

guidedInputs.label: Donor reporting requirements
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. EU quarterly narrative + annual results reporting; indicators must map to EU Global Gateway results chain.

guidedInputs.label: Existing indicators or log frame (if any)
guidedInputs.placeholder: Paste the current log frame rows or indicator list, if one exists.
